lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Left end tab (holed pad, patches 2/5) folded ~90 deg. In the perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer-skin apex of the fold: the nearest scan point is 0.10/0.20/0.13 mm away and the outer-apex height offset is under 0.03 mm. The line is parallel to the fold. It spans about -2.5 to +2.6 mm of the ~5.4 mm tab neck, roughly 95% coverage.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Right end tab (holed pad, patches 2/4) folded ~90 deg. In the sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer apex: the nearest scan point is 0.02/0.02/0.05 mm away. The line is parallel to the fold and covers about 95% of the tab-neck width. This fold sits on the same axis as B1, but the two tabs are separate plates about 50 mm apart, joined only through the base plate, which does not fold between them. That makes them 2 lines, not one interrupted fold.
